parameters.name: ct
parameters.description: overall V1-top coupling c_t, Eq.(1); benchmark 2.0

parameters.name: theta
parameters.description: chirality angle, tan[theta] = cR/cL, Eq.(1); benchmark Pi/2

parameters.name: WV1
parameters.value: ct^2 MV1/(8 Pi) Sqrt[1 - 4 MT^2/MV1^2] (1 - MT^2/MV1^2 (1 - 3 Sin[2 theta]))
parameters.description: V1 total width into ttbar [GeV], Eq.(2)

lagrangian_terms.name: LV1kin
lagrangian_terms.expression: -1/4 FS[V1, mu, nu] FS[V1, mu, nu] + 1/2 MV1^2 V1[mu] V1[mu]

lagrangian_terms.name: LNV1t
lagrangian_terms.expression: ct Cos[theta] tbar.Ga[mu].ProjM.t V1[mu] + ct Sin[theta] tbar.Ga[mu].ProjP.t V1[mu]
